items.rationale: One travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified under 7.1.7(f), and this is the first such charge on the invoice. Using the full rate from priors, about 81.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c). Prior rate is about 26 per piece.
Like-for-like replacement pipe section is a repair cost. Full rate is about 42 per metre.
Standard insulation that was part of the installation is covered under 7.1.7(c). Full rate is about 26 per metre.
Trade labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g). Case 39 paid installer hours (>=76), so I take about 80 per hour × 1; the 480 prior seems to belong to a different line type.
Labour for the repair is covered under 7.1.7(g). Same case as 39 and 51: 9 hours, revealed >=732.
Drying equipment deployment is covered once per drying operation under 7.1.7(e). Full rate is >=580.

items.description: Painting disturbed area and closing opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening is covered under 7.1.7(a). Full rate is >=633.

items.description: Full repaint of entire wall 8 m²
items.rationale: Work beyond the affected patch is excluded by 7.1.5(a)/(b). The 7.1.6 continuous-surface exception does not apply because matching paint is still available.
These are unaffected surfaces and other parts of the room, excluded by 7.1.5 and 7.1.6.
